description: This file is a PHP script handling lead capture functionality in a SuiteCRM environment. It includes security checks, loads language and configuration settings, defines a user array, includes a form handler, processes form submissions for creating leads, and optionally redirects the user after submission.

classes.name: LeadFormBase
classes.description: A class used for handling the lead form, including saving lead data.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: A method that processes the saving of lead data entered via the form.
